scope: source verification of pinned SDK WasmFS JS APIs and Gessa build profiles

api.FS.open: open(path, flags, mode=0o666) returns {fd}; use flags="r".
api.FS.read: read(stream, Uint8Array, offset, length, optional_position) allocates exactly length bytes, calls _wasmfs_read or _wasmfs_pread, copies bytesRead to buffer at offset, frees the temporary allocation and returns the byte count or throws on errno.
api.FS.close: close(stream) closes stream.fd and throws on errno.
api.FS.stat: stat(path) returns an object including mode and size.
api.FS.lstat: lstat(path) exposes the same fields without following the final symlink.
api.FS.readFile: Copies the whole file. Native _wasmfs_read_file stats the file, reallocates a thread-local buffer to the full size, reads the full size, and JS then copies via HEAPU8.slice.

bounded_read_contract: Check lstat mode and exact expected size before allocation/open.
Open read-only, read fixed bounded chunks into a pre-sized Uint8Array using explicit offsets or sequential fd position.
Require each read to return 1..requested until the expected size is reached.
Attempt one further byte to require EOF and detect growth after stat.
Always close the stream in finally.
Validate copied bytes against the in-engine SHA256 on the receiving host.
limitation: This receipt inspects exact source and build flags. The browser probe must still require the functions on the actual Module.FS object at runtime.
